SENIOR EMBEDDED LINUX ENGINEER 
 Role Overview: 
 We are looking for a Senior Embedded Linux Engineer to develop and maintain software platforms for connected embedded devices. The role covers the complete software stack, from bootloader and BSP development to Linux kernel customization, device drivers, system integration, and application support.
 This position is ideal for engineers passionate about software close to hardware and modern Linux-based embedded platforms.
 Your role: 
Develop and maintain Embedded Linux platforms for ARM-based systems.
Customize and maintain Yocto/Linux distributions.
Develop and debug Linux kernel drivers.
Configure and maintain Device Trees.
Develop and customize U-Boot and secure boot solutions.
Integrate hardware peripherals and communication interfaces.
Perform board bring-up and BSP development activities.
Analyze system performance, memory usage, and boot-time optimization.
Support OTA/FOTA update mechanisms.
Collaborate with hardware, systems, and application teams.
 Your profile: 
 Must Have: 
Strong C programming skills
Good C++ knowledge
Linux system internals
Linux kernel architecture
Device Driver Development
Yocto Project
U-Boot
Device Tree
Cross-compilation toolchains
Git
 Desired Experience: 
5+ years in Embedded Software
BSP or Platform development experience
ARM Cortex-A based platforms
Industrial, IoT, Medical or Telecom products
